verdict.rationale: Formant documents a first-party data export path: the Python Cloud SDK queries telemetry, on a page titled data export. Device configuration can also be exported to YAML, an open format. The evidence does not show a complete account-wide export, the output formats of telemetry exports, or any offboarding or exit workflow. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data (telemetry, video, assets, events), explicit open-format output for telemetry exports, an account exit/offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
